title: 第11章 金丹大道第12章 碰瓷
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
那日游神毕竟是城隍帐下一等差役，武艺精熟，巡日令牌法凌厉刁钻，招招不离三寸要害。陶潜近身交手比不过他，当即拉开距离，左手掐诀，右手拐杖一挥，三真风法！
罡风骤起！
无形风刃如万千利刀，裹着尖锐的啸音铺天盖地地碾压过去。日游神猝不及防，被罡风正面掀中，金甲哐当作响，整个人倒飞出去数十丈，在半空中连翻了几个跟头才勉强稳住。
他还未站稳，陶潜后手已到。口喷真火，掌发罡风，上下夹击，火借风势，风助火威！
这一手火风两法连环施展，看似各自独立，实则环环相扣。日游神腹背受敌，巡日令牌左挡右格，手忙脚乱。
须知这修行界中，鬼仙、人仙虽为仙道最末二等，却也远非凡俗可比。只是这两等散仙大多机缘浅薄，修个一两门粗浅法术便算了不得了，更别提什么法宝灵器，多半两手空空。
而那阴司差役虽挂了个“神”字，实则不过是有些武艺傍身的阴差，连正经神职都算不上，法力有限得紧，全凭一身蛮力与城隍令牌的威势行事。
似陶潜这般手握七八种法术、又得云笈道枢加持的鬼仙，放在当世修行者中已算得上一等一的高手，寻常鬼仙人仙见了都要绕道走。
故而这一场厮杀，初时日游神仗着近身武艺尚能周旋，可一旦陶潜拉开距离、连环施法，局面便急转直下。
两人你来我往，斗了十几个回合。
陶潜看准日游神一牌刺空的破绽，桃木拐杖猛地下劈，一杖砸在对方持牌的手腕上！咔嚓一声闷响，骨裂之声清晰可闻，巡日令牌脱手飞出。
日游神惨叫一声，未及收势，陶潜左掌已然拍出，掌心赤焰翻涌，一团三真火正面轰在日游神胸甲之上！
轰！
金甲炸裂，火焰灌入甲缝，日游神浑身冒烟，如断线风筝般倒栽葱坠落下去，砸穿了两层云头，跌入下方一座荒山丛林之中，轰然一声巨响，砸出一个数丈方圆的深坑，碎石泥土飞溅漫天。
陶潜收了火焰，居高临下俯视那深坑。日游神半截身子埋在土里，金甲碎了大半，胸口一片焦黑，嘴角溢出黑血，犹自握着那面城隍令牌不肯松手，双目怒睁，恨恨地瞪着陶潜。
“老道说了，不想跟你动手。”陶潜拄着拐杖，缓缓落下云头，站在坑沿上，“你回去告诉你家城隍，老道已证鬼仙，若不做恶，阴司便无权管辖我，你家城隍也只是一介鬼仙，就算要抓人，也需北帝符诏。”
鬼仙虽是末等小仙，终究也是仙，真有事也需酆都大帝下一道北帝符诏，让他自行归案，如若不从，才武力拘拿。
他顿了顿，桃木拐杖往地面一顿，裂纹如蛛网般向四面八方炸开。
“下回来的，就没这么好的运气了。”
说罢，陶潜袖袍一甩，脚踏罡风，化作一道青光，没入苍茫天际，转瞬不见踪影。

深坑之中，日游神挣扎着爬起半个身子，望着那远去的青光，面色阴晴不定。
半晌，他咬了咬牙，捡起地上的巡日令牌，一瘸一拐地遁入地脉，朝城隍府方向去了。
……
却说那猴子得了陶潜的法诀，径往楚国腹地奔去。
不一日，早来到楚国都城郢都城外。
但见那城池高耸，车水马龙，真个是人烟密集之所。猴子不敢露出本来面目，当即捻着诀，念动“迷仙障”法门，摇身一变，化作个干瘦的游方小道童。
只是他初学变化，那雷公嘴、毛手毛脚的习性到底遮掩不尽，走起路来依旧是一蹿一跳，抓耳挠腮。
这春秋之世，楚国规矩极大，国人、野人泾渭分明，衣冠楚楚者走大道，布衣草鞋者走泥路。
猴子哪里懂这些狗屁规矩？他披着件破道袍，大摇大摆就在市集中央横冲直撞，一会儿拿起摊上的果子嗅嗅，一会儿又蹲在路当中挠痒痒。
content_en:
After all, the God of Wandering was a first-class servant in the City God's account that day. He was proficient in martial arts, and his patrol token skills were very cunning, and his moves could not miss the vital point. Tao Qian couldn't compete with him in close combat, so he immediately distanced himself, made a seal with his left hand, waved his right crutch, and used the Three True Wind Techniques!
The strong wind rises suddenly!
The invisible wind blades were like thousands of sharp knives, crushing over the sky with a sharp whistling sound. Riyushen was caught off guard and was hit from the front by the strong wind. His golden armor clanked and he flew backwards for dozens of feet. He turned several somersaults in mid-air before he managed to stabilize himself.
Before he could stand still, Tao Qian's back-up was already there. The mouth sprays real fire, the palms send out the strong wind, and they attack from up and down. The fire borrows the wind, and the wind assists the power of the fire!
The two techniques of fire and wind are used in succession. They seem to be independent, but in fact they are interlocking. The God of Sun Tour was attacked from both sides, and his patrol token was blocked from left to right, and he was in a hurry.
It should be noted that in this world of cultivation, although ghost immortals and human immortals are the last two levels of immortality, they are far from ordinary people. It's just that most of these two levels of loose immortals have limited opportunities. It's just a matter of practicing one or two superficial spells, let alone magic weapons and spiritual weapons. Most of them are empty-handed.
And even though the underworld officer has the word "god", he is actually just an underworld officer with some martial arts skills. He is not even a serious priest. His magic power is very limited, and he relies on his brute force and the power of the City God's token to act.
A ghost immortal like Tao Qian, who possesses seven or eight kinds of spells and is blessed by Yunji Taoist Priest, is considered a first-rate master among practitioners in the world. Ordinary ghosts, immortals and immortals will take a detour when they see him.
Therefore, in the beginning of this fight, Riyushen was able to survive with his close-quarters martial arts, but once Tao Qian opened the distance and cast spells in succession, the situation took a turn for the worse.
The two of them fought back and forth for more than ten rounds.
Tao Qian saw the flaw in the Riyou Shen's card that stabbed the air. He slashed down with his mahogany crutch and hit the opponent's card-holding wrist with the stick! There was a muffled click and the sound of cracking bones could be heard clearly, and the sun patrol token flew out.
The God of Sunshine screamed, and before he could stop his attack, Tao Qian struck out with his left palm. Red flames surged from his palm, and a ball of three true fires hit the breastplate of the God of Sunshine!
boom!
The golden armor exploded, flames poured into the seams of the armor, and the God of Sun Travel was covered in smoke. He fell upside down like a kite with a broken string, smashed through two layers of clouds, and fell into a barren mountain jungle below. There was a loud bang, and a deep pit with a radius of several feet was made, and gravel and soil flew into the sky.
Tao Qian put away the flame and looked down at the deep pit. Riyushen was half buried in the soil, most of his golden armor was broken, his chest was burnt black, and black blood spilled from the corners of his mouth. He still held the City God's token and refused to let go, his eyes wide open and he glared at Tao Qian hatefully.
"The old Taoist said that I don't want to fight with you." Tao Qian leaned on crutches, slowly lowered his cloud head, and stood on the edge of the pit. "Go back and tell your city god that the old Taoist has proven to be a ghost and immortal. If I don't do evil, the underworld has no right to rule over me. Your city god is just a ghost and immortal. Even if you want to arrest someone, you need the Northern Emperor's talisman."
Although the ghost immortal is a low-level immortal, he is still an immortal after all. If something really happens, Emperor Fengdu will need to issue a decree from the Northern Emperor to let him be brought to justice on his own. If he does not comply, he will be arrested by force.
He paused, and then the peach wood crutch hit the ground, cracks exploding in all directions like spider webs.
"When you come back next time, you won't be so lucky."
After that, Tao Qian flicked his sleeves and robe, stepped on the strong wind, and turned into a ray of green light, which disappeared into the vast sky and disappeared in an instant.
In the deep pit, Riyushen struggled to get up half of his body, looking at the distant blue light with a gloomy expression on his face.
After a while, he gritted his teeth, picked up the sun patrol token on the ground, limped into the ground, and headed towards the City God's Mansion.
…
But he said that the monkey had obtained Tao Qian's secret and ran straight to the hinterland of Chu State.
Not a day later, he arrived outside Yingdu, the capital of Chu State.
But seeing the towering city and the bustling traffic, it was really a densely populated place. The monkey didn't dare to show his true face, so he immediately chanted the magic spell and chanted the "Enchanting Immortal Barrier" method, and transformed into a skinny wanderer.Fang Xiaodaotong.
It's just that he is new to learning, and his bad-mouthed and frivolous habits can't be fully concealed. He still jumps up and down when walking, scratching his ears and cheeks.
In this age of the Spring and Autumn Period, the rules of the Chu State were very great, and the distinction between Chinese and savages was clear. Those who were well-dressed walked on the high road, and those in commoners and straw sandals walked on the dirt road.
How do monkeys understand these bullshit rules? Wearing a tattered monk's robe, he swaggered around in the middle of the market, picking up the fruits on the stall and smelling them, and squatting in the middle of the road to scratch his itch.
